response.overview: Preschool animated compilation feature that brings creator Lucy Cousins' popular picture-book characters to life in a vibrant, low-key format designed for young viewers. The release follows the friendly mouse Maisy and her core animal companions—Tallulah the chick, Charley the crocodile, Cyril the squirrel, and Eddie the elephant—as they explore foundational early-childhood experiences through simple visual storytelling and cheerful acoustic music. Rather than a single narrative movie, the program bundles four distinct thematic adventure blocks (Play with Maisy, Maisy Makes Music, Maisy's Friends, and Maisy's Birthday) that center on imaginative games, introducing musical instruments, learning to share, and celebrating milestones together.
response.title: Play Time Maisy
